name: limit_fillet_face_between_back_to_back_faces
why: The front and the back of the same cube: two planar, parallel faces that turn their backs on each other. No ball touches both of them from the air side, so the fillet is impossible by GEOMETRY, not by a whim of the API. The Checks/FaceFillet probe took its parallel-faces variant out of the run for exactly this reason (REVISION 28/9/2026): a NULL there measures the geometry, not the call. Here the geometry is looked at first, and the refusal says why and what to use instead.
_why_not_the_walls_of_a_pocket: Two parallel walls that FACE EACH OTHER (a pocket) are not refused in the same way: a ball with a radius of half the distance touches both. That branch has no measurement yet, and it does not go into a case until it has one.
